title: Captions
summary: Eleven caption styles in the theme look, playing over the sample clip with its real word timings: Poppins capitals in the theme lettering (navy body, cyan rim, magenta glow) or glowing white, words popping in as they are spoken, highlighter yellow on the spoken or emphasised word.
usage: In a storyboard: {"captions": "one-word"}. one-word is the theme default (one big word in the theme lettering); tall-word is the same with a highlighter rim; phrase, hairline and small-print show a few words; ink-bar is the most readable on bright footage; ink-word is a plain glowing white word; the kinetic styles and outline-pop mark the storyboard's "emphasis" words. Style ids match the fashion theme so storyboards can switch themes.
